caption:
Only need to send a few pages? Split the PDF ✂️

1️⃣ Open pdf.315tools.com and pick Split PDF
2️⃣ Type the parts you want: 1, 2~3, 4~5 makes three files
3️⃣ Press Split, then Download all to get one .zip

Your original file stays exactly as it was, and nothing is uploaded.
